title: A perturbative Liouville prescription for the celestial three-gluon amplitude
summary: We study the celestial three-gluon amplitude in a dilaton background through the Mellin-Liouville formulation proposed by Stieberger, Taylor and Zhu (STZ). The original map contains an ambiguity in the identification of Liouville and Mellin variables; we resolve it by requiring global conformal covariance and compatibility with the semiclassical expansion of Liouville theory. This uniquely fixes the operator normalization and the parameter dictionary, and leads to a controlled expansion in the Liouville coupling $b$.
